description: List all Airtable bases accessible in the current session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'bases' list (id, name, permissionLevel); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the tables within a base, including their field metadata.

base_id.description: The id of the base whose tables to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'tables' list (id, name, primaryFieldId, fields); on failure (base not found), output contains an error message.

description: List records in a table with optional paging and a simple filterByFormula filter.

table_id_or_name.description: The table id or name to read records from.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (1-100, default 100).

offset.description: Optional numeric offset (as a string) to start paging from.

filter_by_formula.description: Optional simple filter of the form {Field}='Value' to match records.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'records' list and optional 'offset'; on failure (table not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single record by its id from a table.

record_id.description: The id of the record to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the record object (id, createdTime, fields); on failure (table or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create one or more records in a table.

table_id_or_name.description: The table id or name to create records in.

records.description: A list of record items, each an object with a 'fields' object of column values.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the created 'records' list; on failure (table not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update (merge) the fields of an existing record.

record_id.description: The id of the record to update.

fields.description: An object of field names to new values, merged into the record's existing fields.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated record object; on failure (table or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a record by its id from a table.

record_id.description: The id of the record to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the deleted record id and deleted:true; on failure (table or record not found), output contains an error message.
